passed_items: Domain entities (ProjectMaster, UseCase, ProjectDefinition, InfrastructureSpecs) with correct attributes and invariants
Value objects immutable; estructura_directorios and reglas_dominio non-empty enforced
Input port ProjectQueryUseCase (get_all_projects, get_project_by_id) defined and implemented by ProjectQueryService
Output port ProjectRepository (find_all, find_by_id) defined and implemented by InMemoryProjectRepository
REST API: GET /api/projects and GET /api/projects/{project_id} with ProjectMasterDTO response
DTOs map domain to API (ProjectMasterDTO.from_domain, UseCaseDTO); checklist and structure fields present
Dependency injection via deps (set_project_query_use_case, get_project_query_use_case) and lifespan wiring in main.py
Domain exceptions (ProjectNotFoundException, IncompleteMetadataException) defined and used in domain layer
Router returns 404 via HTTPException when project not found
failed_items: Global Exception Handling: No FastAPI add_exception_handler for domain exceptions (IncompleteMetadataException, ProjectNotFoundException); only HTTPException(404) used in router.

gaps.description: No global exception handler for domain exceptions (IncompleteMetadataException, ProjectNotFoundException). Unhandled domain exceptions would surface as 500.
gaps.fix_suggestion: In main.py register exception handlers, e.g. app.add_exception_handler(IncompleteMetadataException, ...) and app.add_exception_handler(ProjectNotFoundException, ...) mapping to appropriate HTTP status and body.
